entities.name: Gallus gallus Q5ZLK4
observations: Exact 343-aa sequence match to reviewed UniProt Q5ZLK4, globoside alpha-1,3-N-acetylgalactosaminyltransferase 1.
Annotated as a Golgi apparatus membrane, single-pass type II membrane protein.
May add GalNAc in alpha-1,3 linkage during glycolipid formation; exact endogenous substrate for the chicken protein is uncertain.
GO annotations include globoside alpha-N-acetylgalactosaminyltransferase activity (GO:0047277) and carbohydrate metabolic process (GO:0005975).

entities.name: Glycolipid biosynthesis
observations: Homolog annotations associate the protein family with glycolipid biosynthesis and carbohydrate metabolism; human homolog Q8N5D6 has lost confirmed Forssman glycolipid synthesis activity.

entities.name: Golgi membrane
observations: Reviewed sequence-matched protein annotation places it in the Golgi apparatus membrane as a single-pass type II membrane protein.
